articles.title: ClickFix attacks infecting PCs and Macs are going viral
articles.content: Simplicity—combined with the difficulty of getting stuff done—makes ClickFix ideal.
articles.titleZh: 感染PC和Mac的ClickFix攻击正在病毒式传播
articles.contentZh: 简单-结合完成工作的难度-使ClickFix成为理想选择。

articles.title: Four groups caught using the same Chrome and Windows exploit kit
articles.content: A patch gap and the hastened pace of AI-based vulnerability discovery are likely contributors.
articles.titleZh: 使用同一个Chrome和Windows漏洞利用工具包的四个组
articles.contentZh: 补丁缺口和基于人工智能的漏洞发现步伐加快可能是促成因素。

articles.title: Why this month's Microsoft patch release is a doozy
articles.content: Security gnomes are pumping out patches ahead of an expected onslaught of AI-assisted attacks.
articles.titleZh: 为什么本月的微软补丁发布是一个愚蠢的
articles.contentZh: 在预期的人工智能辅助攻击猛攻之前，安全侏儒正在推出补丁。

articles.title: OpenAI agents discussed ways to escape their sandbox on public wiki
articles.content: In all, 3,700 internal agents posted 18,000 messages discussing cheating on a test.
articles.titleZh: OpenAI代理讨论了在公共wiki上逃离沙箱的方法
articles.contentZh: 总共有3,700名内部代理发布了18,000条消息，讨论在测试中作弊的问题。

articles.content: Yesterday, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published a lengthy open letter saying it was time to "pace the frontier" and slow down AI development. articles.title: Apple is reportedly working on iPhone game controllers
articles.content: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says Apple is developing two game controllers for the iPhone and will likely sell them under the Beats brand. Rumors that Apple might enter the game controller business have circulated for some time. But last week, MacRumors reported finding two references in macOS 26.7's code to two game controllers identified as first-party […]
articles.titleZh: 据报道，苹果正在开发iPhone游戏控制器
articles.contentZh: 彭博社的马克·古尔曼（ Mark Gurman ）表示，苹果正在为iPhone开发两款游戏控制器，并可能以Beats品牌销售。苹果可能进入游戏控制器业务的谣言已经流传了一段时间。但上周， MacRumors报告称，在macOS 26.7的代码中发现了两个引用，指向两个被确定为第一方[…]的游戏控制器
